hikes.name: Mount Si
hikes.blurb: The Seattle area's great training climb: 3,100 feet through forest to a rocky top over North Bend and the Snoqualmie valley.

hikes.name: Rattlesnake Ledge
hikes.blurb: Short switchbacks to a rock ledge hanging over Rattlesnake Lake and Chester Morse Lake beyond.

hikes.name: Little Si
hikes.blurb: A shorter climb past mossy boulders and climbing walls to a knob facing Mount Si's cliffs.

hikes.name: Mailbox Peak
hikes.blurb: Over 4,000 feet up to a summit with an actual mailbox and a view of Rainier.

hikes.name: Twin Falls
hikes.blurb: Along the South Fork Snoqualmie under big trees to a 135-foot falls and a bridge over its upper gorge.

hikes.name: Mason Lake and Bandera Mountain
hikes.blurb: Up an old road and wildflower slopes to a lake basin and a ridge summit over the I-90 valley.

hikes.name: McClellan Butte
hikes.blurb: Long, steep forest climb to a rock summit poking above the I-90 corridor.

hikes.name: Teneriffe Falls
hikes.blurb: Up an old road and switchbacks to a falls ribboning down a long cliff.

hikes.name: Cedar Butte
hikes.blurb: A quieter little summit near Rattlesnake Lake with a look into the Cedar River watershed.

hikes.name: Snoqualmie Falls
hikes.blurb: Down to the base of a 268-foot falls, Washington's most famous, from the overlook above.

hikes.name: Mount Washington
hikes.blurb: From Mount Washington Trailhead, a 7.6-mile round trip to the top of Mount Washington (4,347 ft), with about 3,450 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lake Kulla Kulla
hikes.blurb: From Ira Spring Trailhead, a 7.9-mile round trip to Lake Kulla Kulla, with about 2,750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount Teneriffe
hikes.blurb: From Mount Si Trailhead, a 7.5-mile round trip to the top of Mount Teneriffe (4,787 ft), with about 4,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Gossamer Falls
hikes.blurb: From CCC trailhead parking, a 9.1-mile round trip to Gossamer Falls, with about 1,800 feet of climbing.
